findings.message: Delivered as specified: force field added to RunArchiveRequested, reducer rewritten with full state×force table, ArchiveRefusedError added, archive use case updated to pass force, gate dirty-worktree check on finished, and surface all rejected dispatches as ArchiveRefusedError.

17 new reducer unit tests cover full state×force matrix. 14 new integration tests in 'archive — unfinished runs' cover all required scenarios including stoppedReason/lastError preservation and the review_open+dirty-worktree regression pin.

Delivered as specified: program.ts description and --force help match plan wording verbatim; cliDocs.ts long help covers all required content; archive.ts prefixes ArchiveRefusedError with 'Archive refused:' via instanceof; usage and docs regenerated.

Usage content assertion present in usageOutput.test.ts: describe('phax.usage.kdl archive command content') asserts archive block contains '--force' and 'unfinished'. Drift tests confirmed passing per handoff.

pointers: The dirty-worktree guard for finished runs uses resolveRun's result (raw Node FS) rather than the FileSystem port, meaning the guard silently skips in fake-FS integration tests — confirm via code review that this is intended test-isolation behavior and not a gap in coverage for the finished-run dirty-worktree path.
